title: ENDEX: Incident Resolved — VoterTrack Compromise

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 12:00. VoterTrack is frozen for Precinct 111 and Precinct 112; their records are being rebuilt from the 10/28 export; provisional ballots are issued to affected voters. The public statement is out and Polling Location 6 is confirmed at Carrow Community Church. The incident stays open until the 10/31 pollbook load is verified. The hot wash begins.
finalState: VoterTrack frozen for Precinct 111 and Precinct 112; records rebuilt from the 10/28 export.
Provisional ballots for voters shown as mail ballot issued.
Public statement issued; Polling Location 6 confirmed at Carrow Community Church.
Records under the 22-month retention hold; reports to the Secretary of State, CISA and the FBI.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: What was the most effective action taken during the response, and why?
Where did communication break down, and how could it have been prevented?
How did the air-gapped pollbook rebuild impact trust in the process?
What role did the media and social posts play in shaping public perception during the incident?
How could the CIRP declaration process have been improved to reduce response time?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms, evaluator sheets, and inject decks before the break. Confirm CISA and state liaison roles are documented.

snapshot.title: ENDEX: Incident Resolved — VoterTrack Compromise

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The voter registration database has been restored using an air-gapped, verified copy from October 28. All systems are now operating on clean data. The Board’s public website, hotline, and results portal have been updated with accurate information. The CISA forensic team has sealed and preserved all evidence under chain of custody. The election integrity incident is officially closed.
finalState: VoterTrack database is restored using the air-gapped copy from 10/28/2026.
All public-facing systems now display verified voter data.
The CISA forensic drive (COOP-DR-5) is sealed and under chain of custody.
The Ohio Secretary of State has confirmed the end of the incident.
The Board has issued a final statement confirming that no voters were deleted and all in-person voters were able to cast ballots.
